title: Providers
description: A bundle of healthcare provider records. The Providers wrapper holds a 'provider' array. To use the inner provider as a MongoDB $jsonSchema collection validator, target '#/definitions/provider' and replace 'type' with 'bsonType' throughout. Only npi is required; every other field is optional. Patterns and enums constrain the shape of values that are present.

provider.description: Array of provider records. May be empty.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: A healthcare provider record sourced from the NPPES NPI Registry, enriched with county data. Only npi is required.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId — auto-assigned on insert. Omit on write; always present on read.

npi.description: National Provider Identifier — 10-digit string, globally unique, issued by CMS. Never numeric; leading zeros are significant.

entity_type_code.description: NPI entity type. '1' = individual practitioner. '2' = organization (hospital, pharmacy, group practice, etc.).

provider_enumeration_date.description: Date the NPI was issued by CMS. Format: MM/DD/YYYY (as received from NPPES CSV; not converted to ISO 8601).

last_update_date.description: Date the NPI record was last updated in the NPPES registry. Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

certification_date.description: Date the provider last certified their NPI record with CMS. Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

npi_deactivation_date.description: Date the NPI was deactivated. Present only if the provider has been deactivated. Format: MM/DD/YYYY. If present without npi_reactivation_date, the provider is inactive and flagged as out_of_scope.

npi_reactivation_date.description: Date the NPI was reactivated after a prior deactivation. Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

practice_address.description: Provider practice locations. Either a single address (one location) or an array of addresses (one per location). Index 0 of the array is the primary practice location.

mailing_address.description: Mailing/billing address. May differ from practice_address. Used as fallback geocoding input in Pass 3 (billing retry).

taxonomies.description: Provider specialty taxonomy codes (NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy). Multiple entries represent additional specialties. Exactly one entry should have primary: true when present.

primary.description: True if this is the provider's primary specialty.

licenses.description: Professional licenses held by the provider. Each entry is a state/number pair from the NPPES data.

state.description: US state abbreviation where the license was issued.

number.description: License number as reported by the provider to CMS.

other_identifiers.description: Legacy or alternate provider identifiers (e.g. UPIN, Medicaid, Medicare OSCAR). Parallel array with other_identifier_types and other_identifier_states.

other_identifier_types.description: Type codes for other_identifiers. Common values: '01' = Other, '04' = Medicare UPIN, '05' = Medicaid.

other_identifier_states.description: State associated with each entry in other_identifiers.

other_identifier_issuers.description: Issuing organization for each entry in other_identifiers.

county.description: Doc-level county enrichment result. Records with multiple practice locations also carry a county sub-document on each practice_address element and on mailing_address.

bad_data.description: Set when a provider record fails a data-quality gate. Present only when flagged.

flagged.description: True when the record is flagged. Permanent until source data is corrected.

reason.description: Why the record was flagged. Controlled vocabulary.

out_of_scope.description: Set when a provider record is excluded from operational scope (deactivated, foreign, no usable address, etc.).

flagged.description: True when the record is excluded.

reason.description: Why the record was excluded. Controlled vocabulary.

load_id.description: Pipeline run identifier that wrote this record. Format: '<uuid>:<worker_num>' (sub-orchestrator instance id with the worker suffix).

record_id.description: Sequential integer assigned by the load worker. Unique within a single pipeline run but NOT globally unique across runs — use npi as the stable identifier.

worker_id.description: Index of the pipeline worker that loaded this record. Used for debugging load distribution.

provider_last_name_legal_name.description: Provider's legal last name as registered with CMS. Typically present on individual records (entity_type_code = '1').

provider_first_name.description: Provider's first name. Typically present on individual records.

provider_sex_code.description: Provider sex as reported to CMS.

is_sole_proprietor.description: Whether the individual provider operates as a sole proprietor ('Y'/'N'). Typically present on individual records.

provider_organization_name_legal_busines.description: Legal business name of the organization. Typically present on organization records (entity_type_code = '2').

provider_other_organization_name.description: Alternate or DBA name for the organization.

employer_identification_number_ein.description: Federal EIN for the organization. May be '<UNAVAIL>' if CMS could not obtain it.

is_organization_subpart.description: Whether this organization is a subpart of a larger organization ('Y'/'N').

parent_organization_lbn.description: Legal business name of the parent organization.

parent_organization_tin.description: Tax Identification Number of the parent organization.

authorized_official_last_name.description: Last name of the authorized official responsible for the NPI record.

authorized_official_first_name.description: First name of the authorized official.

authorized_official_middle_name.description: Middle name of the authorized official.

authorized_official_title_or_position.description: Job title or position of the authorized official.

authorized_official_telephone_number.description: Phone number of the authorized official. Digits only, no formatting.

authorized_official_credential_text.description: Professional credential of the authorized official.

embedding.description: Vector embedding of the provider record for semantic search.

embedding_text.description: Text source used to generate the embedding (truncated for storage efficiency).

embedding_model.description: Identifier of the embedding model used (e.g. 'text-embedding-3-large').

embedding_version.description: Version stamp of the embedding pipeline that produced this vector.

address.title: Address
address.description: A US mailing or practice address as reported in the NPPES NPI registry. May carry a nested county sub-document (per-address county enrichment, post-multi-practice-address migration).

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory abbreviation.

zip.description: ZIP code. May be 5-digit ('30024') or ZIP+4 ('30024-1234'). Stored as a string to preserve leading zeros.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. 'US' for domestic providers. Foreign values trigger out_of_scope with reason 'foreign_provider'.

phone.description: Phone number as reported by NPPES. May be digits only or include formatting.

fax.description: Fax number as reported by NPPES.

county.description: Per-address county enrichment result. Present on practice_address elements (and mailing_address) in records produced after the multi-practice-address migration.

county.title: CountyEnrichment
county.description: Result of the county enrichment pipeline. Sits at the document level (legacy) OR nested per-address (post-multi-practice-address migration). Includes a derived urban flag from the U.S. Census 2020 county urban-rural tabulation.

fips.description: 5-digit FIPS county code (2-digit state + 3-digit county). Null when enrichment failed (geocoder_failed) or provider/address is excluded (out_of_scope*). Example: '30063' = Missoula County, MT.

name.description: Human-readable county name (e.g. 'Missoula County'). Present when fips is set via crosswalk or Maps. Absent for some sources (e.g. Census batch geocoder does not return county name).

source.description: Which enrichment pass assigned the county. Determines reliability and method of the assignment.

x-enum-descriptions.crosswalk_pass1: ZIP -> county via ZipCountyCrosswalk (res_ratio >= 0.98). Fastest path, ~82% of providers.
x-enum-descriptions.crosswalk_zip_fixed: ZIP crosswalk applied after zip_state_mismatch detection corrected the state.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass2_batch: U.S. Census Geocoder batch API on practice address.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass2_batch_billing: U.S. Census Geocoder batch API on practice address with mailing fallback (legacy combined Pass 2 path).
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass3_billing: U.S. Census Geocoder batch API on mailing/billing address (Pass 2 fallback).
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass4_maps: Google Maps Geocoding API on practice address. Paid API.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass5_maps_billing: Google Maps Geocoding API on billing address. Paid API.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass6_nppes: NPI looked up in NPPES registry; returned address tried against ZIP crosswalk.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_failed: All enrichment passes exhausted without a result.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_no_address: Element has no usable line1 / city to geocode.
x-enum-descriptions.out_of_scope: Address (or provider) excluded from enrichment. See 'reason' for the criterion.
x-enum-descriptions.out_of_scope_zip_state_mismatch: Per-address flag: this address's ZIP does not match its state and license-based repair did not resolve it.

reason.description: Exclusion reason. Present when source = 'out_of_scope' or 'out_of_scope_zip_state_mismatch'. Controlled vocabulary; new values may be added without schema churn.

zip_ratio.description: Residential ratio of the ZIP code used for crosswalk assignment (0.0 - 1.0). Present only when source = 'crosswalk_pass1'.

urban.description: Urban-vs-rural classification of the county. True = urban (>=50% of county population in 2020 Census urban areas). Derived from U.S. Census 2020_UA_COUNTY tabulation per EPIC-010-F-007-S-011-REQ-T-002.
